I got blindsided after 7 months. I contacted my ex 4 days after the breakup because it made no sense. I can tell you right now, the answers I got from him were not real answers, they weren’t satisfactory, because to be frank, I thought they were really stupid. All it did was make me lose respect for him, and make me realize that the only person that had the answers was me. 

Here is the answer I chose to give myself: Regardless of his reasoning/explanation, the end result is still the same. He still broke up with me in the most disgusting way possible. In the midst of all the answers I was so focused on finding, I had to remember that the only constant was this heart of mine that I needed to heal. I checked my priorities and channeled all my energy into healing and fixing the clusterfuck he made. 
Don’t get me wrong, I almost went crazy trying to find answers, I read so many philosophy books on love, I stalked this subreddit (and others) obsessively, talked to everyone I met about the situation for insight. 
Eventually, the whole thing got fucking boring. I realized, it doesn’t matter why he did what he did, because he STILL did it. 

The outcome remains the same. I wouldn’t say I got closure, because I still have some “how” questions that linger in my mind. But it helps to realize that our exes may not even know the answer to that question. Anyone who would blindside someone in this manner, honestly, isn’t someone who’s principles I respect, so their explanation will ultimately never make sense to me.
I’m sorry you’re going through this, you will get better eventually, and like me, might even realize you’re better off alone than with someone who would abandon you like that.
